title: Senior Technical Marketing Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) to join our team. This is a remote role within the USA, reporting to the Director Technical Marketing Engineer in the Product Management department. We are seeking a hands-on, self-starting Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) with deep networking expertise to drive technical enablement, customer validation, and field readiness for our next-generation Zero Trust Branch solutions. In this high-impact role, you will architect and maintain complex lab environments, lead hands-on Proof of Value (POV) customer engagements, and provide technical troubleshooting to resolve escalations. As the bridge between engineering and field teams, you will author comprehensive deployment guides, technical collateral, and test plans while delivering interactive training to systems engineers and partners. This is an ideal position for a practitioner who thrives on solving real-world enterprise networking challenges and accelerating customer adoption across distributed edge environments.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

•
Lead Customer Proof of Value (POV) Engagements & Field Validations by directly owning and executing hands-on technical POVs, architectural demonstrations, and pilot evaluations with enterprise prospects and customers to validate technical capabilities, eliminate sales friction, and accelerate enterprise deal closure

•
Architect, Build, and Maintain Advanced Lab Topologies by designing, deploying, and maintaining resilient physical and virtual networking lab environments simulating complex enterprise branch, edge, retail network topologies to rigorously test product behavior, interoperability, and real-world scale

•
Drive Complex Technical Troubleshooting & Escalation Resolution by serving as the direct technical escalation bridge between field teams and core engineering to diagnose, reproduce, and resolve critical L2/L3 networking escalations, network segmentation challenges, and packet-level anomalies during active customer pilots

•
Author Technical Documentation, Deployment Guides, and Reference Architectures by developing production-ready technical collateral, including step-by-step deployment runbooks, reference architectures, white papers, competitive test plans, and solution briefs to standardize best practices and accelerate post-sales time-to-value

•
Deliver Field Readiness & Enablement Training by creating and conducting high-impact technical training programs, interactive workshops, and technical webinars for Systems Engineers (SEs), professional services, and channel partner architects to scale deployment self-sufficiency across distributed enterprise environments

Who You Are (Success Profile)

•
Operate with a strong ownership mindset, combining a passion for the mission with high integrity and the ability to navigate seamlessly between strategic planning and hands-on execution.

title: Office Coordinator (Contract)
description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands - including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank - to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

As an office coordinator at Sierra, you will be responsible for creating and operating exceptional workplace environments that enable our teams to do the best work. You will bring the same level of craftsmanship, intensity, and customer obsession to our physical spaces that we bring to the products we build for our customers.

In this role, you will own day-to-day office operations, including the experience across our customer facing spaces at our San Francisco headquarters. You will partner closely with Operations, IT and HR teams to ensure every office runs seamlessly and reflects Sierra’s high standards.

We are looking for a hospitality-minded, detail-oriented person who can effectively prioritize in a fast-paced environment. You should take deep pride in delivering an exceptional experience for employees, candidates, customers, and visitors.

This role is based in San Francisco and is fully onsite five days per week given the hands-on nature of the position.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Oversee the daily operations of our customer-facing spaces.

- Greet guests at reception and foster a warm, welcoming office environment.

- Pick up incoming mail, distribute packages to employees, and coordinate package pickups.

- Manage office inventory and assemble gift packages, including baby and customer gifts.

- Support Executive Assistants with meeting logistics, including lunch and coffee setup for customer and internal executive meetings.

- Track CPR and First Aid certifications for office staff and ensure first aid kits and safety equipment are stocked and up to date.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for facilities requests and repairs, partnering with property management as needed.

- Partner with the People team on new hire onboarding logistics, including workspace setup, badge access, and office orientation.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

- 2-4 years of experience in office coordination, administrative, or a similar role.

- Strong organizational and communication skills.

- The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and adapt to shifting priorities.

- A commitment to unreasonable hospitality and a willingness to go above and beyond for employees and guests.

- Previous experience in a customer-facing position is preferred.

OUR VALUES

title: Marketing Designer, Web
description:
Overview of the role:
PolicyMe is building a simpler, more affordable insurance experience for Canadian families. Our website is where customers learn, build trust, and take the next step toward coverage. We’re hiring a Marketing Designer, Web to raise the visual quality of that experience. You’ll design, improve, and maintain our marketing site built using Webflow; turn Growth briefs into polished, component-led pages; and own quality through launch. Most of your work will be web and CMS-based, with select opportunities to support campaign creative, slides, ads, email UI, and other brand assets.
This is not a product-design, UX-research, or front-end developer role. We need a strong visual designer with exceptional judgment in typography, hierarchy, layout, responsive design, and the details that make a page feel considered. You don’t need to be a Webflow expert on day one: CMS fluency, good technical judgment, and an appetite to learn matter more.
What you'll be doing:

Design and ship great marketing web experiences

• Turn Growth and Content briefs into polished Figma designs for landing pages, product pages, editorial hubs, and campaigns.

• Build clear, conversion-aware, accessible, and responsive layouts using our design system and existing components.

• Design new components when needed, extending our design system in a cohesive, reusable way.

• Improve the marketing site’s everyday surfaces, including navigation, templates, content modules, and EN/FR experiences (French language is not required) with the same care as major launches.

• Bring a point of view to how PolicyMe shows up visually. As a startup, you’ll have meaningful input into the evolution of our web and marketing design identity, in partnership with Growth and Design leadership.
Own CMS quality and publishing

• Learn and use our CMS and Webflow environment to build, update, and publish pages.

• Own pre- and post-launch quality: responsive checks, visual QA, content and link validation, localization review, and clear resolution of inconsistencies.

• Maintain and improve reusable Figma and CMS components, templates, and guardrails so the team can ship faster without compromising quality.
Lead implementation with development agencies

• Create complete handoffs for Webflow/development partners, covering interaction states, edge cases, annotations, and walkthroughs.

• Manage design feedback through implementation and ensure launched work matches the intended experience.

• Coordinate with Growth, Content, Design, and Engineering to clarify scope, surface dependencies, and keep projects moving.
Be involved in Growth’s broader creative work

• Support selected needs across campaign creative, ads, slide templates, email UI, illustrations, and other marketing assets.

• Use AI design tools-including Claude Design-to explore quickly, create wireframes and variations, and improve production speed, while applying strong human judgment to every final output.

What we are looking for:

Need to have’s:

• 2-4 years of experience in marketing, web, brand, or related digital design. Exceptional portfolios matter more than an exact number of years.

• A portfolio made up of highly polished marketing websites or landing pages, plus evidence of breadth across formats such as campaign work, motion, illustration, presentations, ads, or email.

• Excellent Figma skills and a sharp eye for typography, spacing, composition, hierarchy, image selection, and responsive behaviour.

• A meticulous, reliable approach to quality and a willingness to own both high-visibility launches and routine CMS/site-maintenance work.

With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re looking for a  Systems Engineer, Data and Integrations  to join our Systems Engineering team and own the data that runs Fivetran's business. In this role, you will learn the data models behind our sales, billing, and customer operations, design how data should be structured to support those processes, and build the transformations and pipelines that move data reliably between our internal systems.

This position sits at the crossroads of data engineering, data modeling, and business process, ensuring our internal data is accurate, well-structured, and ready to scale. You will partner closely with our Systems and Analytics Engineering teams, as well as Sales Operations, Finance, and other business partner teams.

This is a full-time position based out of our Novi Sad, Serbia office.

Technologies You’ll Use
Our core systems are Salesforce, Netsuite, Coupa, Workday, and Zendesk, with Salesforce at the center of our sales and billing data. Our current integration stack includes Celigo and Fivetran itself.

Working knowledge of one or more of our business applications, with a desire to keep learning, is necessary. You should also be fluent in SQL and strong in a general purpose programming language such as Python or Typescript.

A data engineering background is strongly preferred, with proficiency in data modeling, ETL/ELT development, data quality testing, and data validation. Help us bring established data engineering practices to internal business systems!

• Define and enforce standards for data quality, data modeling, and governance across internal systems.

• Build monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks that give end-to-end visibility into data freshness and accuracy.

title: Direct Response Creative Strategist and Ad Writer
description:
About Scaling.com

Scaling.com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less. As far as we know, we are the only true scaling research advisory firm in the world. Not “growth,” but scale.
We work with entrepreneurs doing $1 million or more in revenue (With many of our clients between $100M and $1B+) who are ready to stop being the bottleneck and build a company that scales.
Our creative library includes multiple NYT best-selling books, large podcast appearances, keynotes, live events, client/member interviews, case studies, client/member training material, webinars, founder content, and hundreds of verified customer stories.
Why This Role Exists
Scaling.com tests hundreds of hooks each week. When the market tells us a hook is working, this role turns that signal into a larger family of direct-response video ads. We are looking for someone who has already written high-performing video creative and scripts at the volume and quality required to support multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.
You will not begin with a blank page. You will receive a winning hook, a proven video ad, or a clear performance signal. Your job is to understand why it worked, find the strongest evidence and source material connected to it in our media library, develop the angle, write new versions, and hand the production team a clear creative direction that can become a finished ad.
This is primarily a video-ad strategy and scriptwriting role. It combines direct-response strategy, AI-assisted research, source mining, writing, creative iteration, and performance learning. You should also be capable of handling other direct-response copywriting needs when required, but video scripts are the center of the job.
Requirements
Your Core Workflow

• Receive winning hooks, proven video ads, winners and losers, hook data, creative references, and testing requests from our Head of Content and paid-media team.

• Diagnose why it worked: the audience, pain, belief, promise, proof, curiosity, identity, or objection it activated. Continually contribute original concepts, competitor references, and new test ideas to the team's shared concept pool.

• Use AI to search our content database for supporting material across testimonials, founder podcasts, books, posts, keynotes, trainings, member stories, and excerpts from our twice-yearly live events. Stay deeply current by regularly consuming our books, every founder podcast appearance and keynote, live-event content, trainings, and the weekly case-study podcast produced for our members.

• Build an evidence bank around the angle. This may include dozens of testimonials, short proof points, founder clips, book lines, customer language, objections, and supporting stories.

• Write three or four new hook options, develop the body, choose the proof sequence, and create a clear flow for the video ad.

• Package the developed angle for a Creative Producer and Editor. Give them the message, key lines, source material, intended flow, and what the ad must accomplish without prescribing every visual decision.

• Review the finished ad to protect the strategy and clarify anything that was lost in execution.

• When an ad wins, create new variations by changing the hook, body, proof, order, framing, or CTA, and by recombining elements from multiple winners.

• When the paid-media team flags a winning ad for refresh, identify what should be preserved and what should change so the next version can beat it.

• Repeat the cycle quickly. Some ads may only perform for a few weeks because we intend to scale spend aggressively.

What You Own

• Winning-hook expansion

• Angle development

• AI-assisted source research

• Testimonial and proof mining

• Video ad scripts and copy

• Hook and body variations

• Creative briefs and source packages

• Winner iteration

• Winner refreshes

• Performance learning

• Claim and source accuracy

title: Senior Consultant, Human Threats
description:
About Coalfire

Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world.

But that’s not who we are - that’s just what we do.
 
We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.

Position Summary:
The Human Threats Senior Consultant will serve as a senior technical consultant on the DivisionHex Human Threats team, assessing the security posture and human-centered detection and response capabilities of client organizations. The role will place a strong emphasis on authorized physical security assessments, including facility access controls, perimeter and entry-point security, visitor and badge-management processes, secure-area protections, employee behaviors, and other physical safeguards. The Senior Consultant will also perform and support social engineering activities, including phishing, vishing, pretext development, human risk assessment, and awareness and behavior measurement, to evaluate how physical and digital attack paths can exploit people, processes, and technology.
 
The ideal candidate will bring expert-level knowledge of physical security assessment methodologies and adversary tradecraft, along with deep experience in one or more social engineering disciplines. They will work with the Managing Principal of Human Threats, Project Managers, Directors, and client Points of Contact to plan and execute engagements, meet project requirements, and provide subject matter expertise across social engineering domains. As a trusted client advisor, the Senior Consultant will use objective testing, onsite assessment activities, social engineering exercises, and clear reporting to help clients identify weaknesses, prioritize remediation, and improve resilience against physical and other human-centric threats.

Why You’ll Want to Join Us

At Coalfire, you’ll find the support you need to thrive personally and professionally. In many cases, we provide a flexible work model that empowers you to choose when and where you’ll work most effectively - whether you’re at home or an office.

Regardless of location, you’ll experience a company that prioritizes connection and wellbeing and be part of a team where people care about each other and our communities. You’ll have opportunities to join employee resource groups, participate in in-person and virtual events, and more. And you’ll enjoy competitive perks and benefits to support you and your family, like paid parental leave, flexible time off, certification and training reimbursement, digital mental health and wellbeing support membership, and comprehensive insurance options.

At Coalfire, equal opportunity and pay equity is integral to the way we do business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Coalfire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. title: Senior C ++ Software Engineer
description:
Overview
MRMS - Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor - is one of the National Weather Service's core operational products for precipitation estimation, and it's built on code that never stops improving. As FWI's MRMS Hydromet Development Advisor supporting NSSL, you will apply specialized technical expertise to guide the ongoing optimization of the MRMS Hydromet/QPE (quantitative precipitation estimation) codebase in support of the upcoming VCP-Agnostic version of MRMS - gathering facts, analyzing existing code and data, and developing recommendations and strategies for the development team. If you like advising on production C++ strategy for a system that operational forecasters rely on every day, this is your kind of project.
Work Schedule and Location:
Remote : This full-time remote position will work Monday through Friday, 8 AM CST to 5 PM CST.
Responsibilities

• Apply specialized technical knowledge to analyze the existing MRMS Hydromet/QPE codebase and develop recommendations and strategies for the planned VCP-Agnostic version of MRMS

• Advise on and, where appropriate, modify existing C++ code or contribute new code to support the ongoing optimization of the MRMS Hydromet/QPE processing software suite

• Provide expert technical guidance to project staff on software design, coding approach, and technical risk for MRMS development activities

• Provide technical documentation (e.g., schematics, code repositories, test reports) for development activities

• Prepare quarterly reports of status

Qualifications
Required:

• BA/BS in a technical or business discipline

• 4+ years of professional and/or academic experience

Desired:

• Software programming skills (C++ required, Perl, Python, and Bash preferred)

• Software development experience (Git)

• Demonstrated ability to advise technical teams on software architecture, coding strategy, and development risk

• Communication skills, including technical writing

• Ability to work as part of a technical team

• Familiarity with meteorological datasets, including output from weather radar systems (preferred)

Work Setting and Environment:

• Primary location: Remote

• Normal work hours are Monday through Friday, 8 hours per day / 40 hours per week, excluding federal holidays; field data-collection activities may require irregular hours during active severe weather events

• Local and non-local travel may be required, not anticipated to exceed 5% annually; all unplanned travel must be approved in writing by the COR at least 10 calendar days in advance

• Must complete an online IT security awareness course within one week of starting work

• Foreign national candidates are subject to export control review and require CO/COR approval prior to consideration

• Government-furnished equipment provided, including access to HPC resources, specialized mobile observation platforms, laboratory test equipment, computers, and office workspace, as applicable

FWI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets.
Why Join Our Team
At FWI, we place the highest importance on creating an exceptional employee experience. You'll have opportunities to achieve your career aspirations through internal promotions, professional development, and other recognition and rewards programs. Join our team and take advantage of the many benefits we offer, including:

• Health Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Long-term and Short-term Disability Insurance

• Life Insurance

• 401(k) Plan

• Holiday Pay

• Paid Time Off

Pay Range
$81,000.00 to $85,000.00

title: Database Administrator (DBA)
description:

We are at the forefront of developing solutions that empower businesses. Our commitment to excellence, coupled with a collaborative, forward-thinking culture, has made us the preferred choice for top-tier talent. • Experience in the installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of PostgreSQL databases.

• Knowledge of database security principles and best practices.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and collaborate with stakeholders.

What Will Make You Stand Out:

• Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate or PostgreSQL Certified Professional

title: Project Management (Central Operations) - Gurugram (Contractual)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.

Join FlixBus India and play a key role in expanding one of India's fastest-growing intercity mobility networks. As part of the Project Associate - Operations team, you will drive the execution and closure of compliance initiatives across all operating regions. You will be the central coordination point between Safety, Fleet Coordinators (FCs), Regional Operations Managers (ROMs), Ground Operations, and external stakeholders - ensuring critical processes are actioned, tracked, and closed on time. Beyond follow-ups, you will dig into operational and compliance data across multiple datasets to surface trends, identify root causes for recurring issues, and turn insights into better process adherence and operational performance.

About the role

• Coordinate with regional and field teams to drive the timely closure of action items.

• Track compliance against defined processes and highlight gaps or delays proactively.

• Analyse operational and compliance data across multiple datasets to identify trends, surface insights, and support root-cause analysis for recurring issues - not just report numbers.

• Maintain trackers and status reports for ongoing initiatives.

• Follow up with stakeholders to ensure accountability and adherence to timelines.

• Support governance of operational, compliance, and safety-related programs.

• Escalate overdue actions and unresolved issues to the relevant stakeholders.

• Assist in the execution of cross-functional projects and process improvement initiatives.

About you

• 1-3 years of experience in operations, program management, compliance, or project coordination.

• Strong stakeholder management and excellent communication skills.

• High ownership and follow-through - you close loops and hold others accountable without being chased.

• Working knowledge of SQL and Power BI, plus solid Excel / Google Sheets skills.

• The ability to manage multiple trackers simultaneously and stay organised under competing priorities.

• A data-driven approach to problem solving, with strong analytical skills - able to deeply interpret data, run deep dives across multiple datasets, proactively spot trends, and drive root-cause analysis (RCA).

Nice to have

• Experience in mobility, logistics, transportation, or fleet operations.

• Knowledge of or hands-on experience with vibe coding and AI tools to automate processes and develop solutions.

We recognise that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply - we want to hear from you!

What we offer

• Hybrid work model: a 5-day work week with 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.

• The opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling, tech-driven environment shaping the future of mobility.

• High-impact ownership of governance and compliance execution across operating regions.

• Broad cross-functional exposure to Safety, Operations, Ground Operations, and external stakeholders.

• A learning and development budget and clear growth exposure into broader operations and program management roles.

Why join Flix

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

3007 - SVP, Data Solutions, UK

Sitting within the UK Data Tech & Analytics team, you’ll be accountable for the delivery of Data Solutions including Private data network and Open intelligence itself in the UK and work as part of a cross WPP Media group spanning DTA, Partnerships, Investment, and our Technology Solutions teams to bring this to market and onboard clients. You will serve as the face of the Data solutions to internal teams and represent the capability in client sales engagements.

Key responsibilities

• Own the design the delivery and roadmap for Open intelligence in the UK, managing across stakeholder groups in DTA/MMD/DTS and leadership to represent UK solutions.

• Program lead the development of the Private data network and Open intelligence solutions across the UK and into global product teams to ensure UK requirements are being prioritized in the roadmap.

• Establish commercial bundling opportunities for partners and clients with WPP owned/bought/licensed data opportunities across the martech landscape.

• Support early-stage new business pitches, among agency leadership, and in client-facing meetings to represent our data solutions in the UK.

• Ensure clear product marketing communications to internal stakeholders.

• Establish governance and guardrails for data solutions capabilities across media solutions, practices and commercial viability across all data solutions and touchpoints.

• Establish the UK enablement strategy into clients with collaboration with the broader global and local product and solutions teams.

 

Skills and Experience

• 10+ years experience in data strategy, data partnerships, proprietary media within a media agency or related company (e.g. publisher, ad tech, client marketing org)

• Strong client direct experience in value proposition and client benefit narratives, with the ability to create contextual client benefit for WPP Media.

• Be the voice of clients for data solutions in the UK and how our local market nuances are represented and delivered through our WPP Open platform.

• Experience designing and developing monetized data solutions in media.

• Strong knowledge of UK data partner landscape, data monetization models, proprietary media products

• Experience helping set clear strategy, roadmapping, operationalizing solutions & organizing resources to deliver

• Excellent written and verbal communications style, in particular being able to translate non-technical use cases into technical requirements

title: Narrative Coach
description:
Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society. 

Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society.  
Stand Together Foundation seeks a Narrative Coach who will provide communications subject matter expertise to support Catalyst partners, a network of national nonprofit organizations.  This coach will help our nonprofit partners explore and articulate narratives that showcase principles in action, and they'll have a particular focus on adapting narrative work that's been done to different kinds of delivery (writing op-eds, delivering keynote remarks, serving on a panel, being a guest on a podcast).   
The Narrative Coach will support nonprofit leaders to move from reciting what their organization does to successfully telling a story that moves a donor, a partner, or their own team. A successful Narrative Coach will work directly with nonprofit leaders to surface and own their narrative, then help them carry that narrative into external-facing material.   
This is an ideal position for a communications professional with a background in marketing and communications who enjoys helping leaders uncover, refine, and confidently deliver narratives that showcase principles in action across a variety of formats and audiences.   
Remote candidates will be considered on a case by case basis.
 

Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.   
 
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success.  That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect.

You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

title: Manager, Product Design: AI Products
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

AI is a top strategic priority for New Relic, and the Bengaluru design team is at the center of it. The team works across three closely related product clusters: autonomous incident response (SRE Agent, Autopilot, and Intelligent RCA), the intelligence and platform layer that powers them (Ground Truth, Agentic Platform, and New Relic AI), and AIOps for event correlation and incident management. These products share a common design challenge: users need to trust systems that act autonomously, and building that trust through good design is genuinely hard work.

This is an on-site role in Bengaluru. Your designers are there, and many of your engineering and product partners are too. Being present - in standups, reviews, and the quick conversations before a decision gets made - is part of how you'll build the relationships that make design effective. You'll also collaborate with design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain, so operating across time zones and communicating well in writing are part of the job.

 

You'll manage a small team of designers and own the quality of the work across these products. The design questions here don't have established answers - how do you make an autonomous system legible? How do you build user trust in AI-generated root cause analysis? How do you design a handoff from machine decision to human judgment? If you're already working in AI product design, or actively building toward it, and you want to lead a team on problems where the playbook doesn't exist yet, this is that role.

What you'll do

• Manage and develop your designers - run consistent 1:1s including regular career development conversations, give direct and specific feedback, set clear expectations for each person, and invest in their growth. Build a team culture where people feel they belong and different perspectives are welcome. You'll represent your team in calibration conversations and advocate for their work and careers within the broader design org.

• Own design quality across AI Products - review work critically, raise problems before they reach partners, and make sure the team is solving the right problems at the right level of craft. For these products, that means consistently asking: does this design make the system legible? Does it earn trust or just assert it?

• Keep the user's perspective in the conversation - design managers at New Relic are the voice of the user in product and engineering discussions. For AI products, that means bringing user research and real-world usage patterns into roadmap conversations, and pushing back when a feature optimizes for the AI's capability rather than the user's understanding of it.

• Partner with PM and Engineering - work with your product and engineering counterparts as a peer. Hold the design perspective, push back when the direction needs it, and communicate design's value in terms the business tracks: adoption, incident resolution time, customer retention.

• Keep the team focused and on track - manage incoming work, maintain visibility into what's in flight, help the team balance competing priorities, and set clear expectations with PM and Engineering partners about what's possible and when.

• Help your team design for AI well - bring a genuine point of view on AI interaction design: trust, transparency, human-in-the-loop moments, designing for systems that act before the user asks. Use AI tools actively in your own workflow - Figma AI, Claude, G

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

ABOUT THE HEALTHCARE TEAM

- Our healthcare agents already reach over 50% of U.S. families. We partner with leading health plans, providers, and healthcare platforms to deliver AI agents that handle some of the most sensitive and high stakes conversations in any industry. From helping members understand their benefits to resolving billing questions with empathy, our healthcare agents are transforming how patients and policyholders interact with the healthcare system.

- Our healthcare customers include major health insurance networks, nonprofit providers, multi-site primary and urgent care practices, healthcare diagnostics companies, and healthcare financial platforms.

- Join us to transform the patient experience across the healthcare system-and help build technology that makes care more accessible, more human and more affordable for everyone.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design and deliver production-grade AI agents for healthcare: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and empathetic AI agents that handle sensitive patient and member interactions. These agents help people understand their coverage, find providers, schedule appointments, navigate billing, and more-all while maintaining strict HIPAA compliance and the trust that healthcare demands.

- Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments serving healthcare payers, providers, and platforms.

- Partner with healthcare leaders: You'll work directly with executives and technical teams at health plans, provider networks, and healthcare technology companies to understand their most pressing challenges - from managing high call volumes to reducing administrative burden and building AI agents that transform how they operate at scale.

- Navigate healthcare complexity: You’ll develop deep expertise in healthcare systems and workflows, including integrations across EHR and patient access platforms, payer and provider operations, and common healthcare data and interoperability standards. You’ll become fluent in the nuances of benefits and eligibility, claims and billing, scheduling and intake, and translate that understanding into exceptional, trustworthy AI experiences.

- Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with healthcare customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development in healthcare.

• Kliniken unterstützen: Du arbeitest mit den Kliniken zusammen, um den Übergang von der stationären Reha in die digitale Nachsorge so reibungslos wie möglich zu gestalten.

• Produkt mitgestalten: Dein Feedback aus der täglichen Arbeit mit Patient:innen fließt direkt in die Weiterentwicklung von myReha ein.

Requirements
Was macht Deine Bewerbung erfolgreich?

• Therapeutische Ausbildung: Du bist Logopäd:in, Ergotherapeut:in, Neuropsycholog:in oder Physiotherapeut:in - mit abgeschlossener Ausbildung oder Studium.

• Klinische Erfahrung: Du hast mit Patient:innen gearbeitet, idealerweise in der neurologischen Rehabilitation. Du weißt, was ein Schlaganfall oder eine Hirnverletzung für den Alltag bedeutet.

• Kommunikationsstärke: Deine Patient:innen sehen dich nicht - du überzeugst und motivierst über Sprache, Stimme und Schrift.

• Eigenständiges Arbeiten: Du arbeitest remote und organisierst deinen Patientenstamm selbstständig. Du brauchst keine tägliche Anleitung.

• Bonus: Erfahrung mit digitaler Therapie, Telerehabilitation oder der DRV-Nachsorge (IRENA).

Über den CV hinaus

• Empathie mit Struktur: Du verstehst, dass Patient:innen nach der Entlassung verunsichert sind - und gibst ihnen Halt, ohne den roten Faden zu verlieren.

• Motivationstalent: Manche Patient:innen brauchen einen Schubs, andere ein offenes Ohr. Du erkennst, was gerade gebraucht wird.

• Digital-affin: Du arbeitest gerne mit Apps und digitalen Tools - und siehst in der Technologie eine Chance, nicht eine Hürde.

• Teamplayer auf Distanz: Du arbeitest remote, bist aber trotzdem eng mit dem Team verbunden - du teilst Erfahrungen, fragst nach und bringst dich ein.

Warum nyra health

• Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du hilfst Patient:innen direkt bei ihrer Genesung

• Schnell wachsendes Digital-Health-Scaleup mit internationaler Ambition

• Flexibles Remote-Arbeiten - vereinbar mit deinem Leben

• Full-time oder Part-time möglich

• Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und kurze Entscheidungswege

• Attraktive Vergütung

• Regelmäßige Team-Events und ein Office am Schottentor

• Die vermutlich besten Mario Kart-Fahrer:innen der österreichischen Startup-Szene 😉

Der Ablauf

• Intro Call (~30 Min): Background, Motivation und ein Überblick über nyra health und die Rolle.

• Gespräch mit unserem Health Lead: Teamfit, Arbeitsweise und gegenseitige Erwartungen - letzter Schritt vor dem Angebot.

You will work closely with detection engineers, threat intelligence analysts, incident response leadership, and our global Security Operations teams to build and refine detections, improve signal quality, execute threat hunts, automate workflows, and respond to complex security incidents with speed and precision.

description:
Job Title: Co-op, Clinical Pharmacology & Pharmacometrics
Job Location: Remote, USA
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
About the Role:

This application is for a 6-month student role from January - June 2027. Resume review begins in October 2026.

The Clinical Pharmacology & Pharmacometrics (CPP) team leverages pharmacology, quantitative modeling, and simulation to support data-driven drug development decisions. CPP generates insights into how drugs interact with the body and helps optimize dosing strategies from early research through regulatory approval and lifecycle management.

At Biogen, CPP works in a highly collaborative and flexible environment that supports a diverse portfolio of therapeutic programs. Team members partner closely with colleagues across Research, Clinical Development, Regulatory, and other functions to inform development strategy and optimize patient outcomes. While Clinical Pharmacology scientists often focus on translational and project strategy and Pharmacometrics scientists specialize in quantitative modeling, team members frequently work across disciplines to meet program needs.

This Co-op role sits within the Pharmacometrics team and offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP), artificial intelligence, and model-based meta-analysis (MBMA) in the autoimmune therapeutic area. The co-op will contribute to the development of mechanistic QSP models, explore the use of AI/machine learning tools to enhance and accelerate QSP modeling workflows, and perform MBMA to generate quantitative evidence that informs drug-development decisions. This role provides hands-on exposure to cutting-edge modeling approaches in industry drug development, with direct impact on portfolio strategy.

What You’ll Do:
As a co-op, you will have the job as described below, but not limited to:

• Contribute to the development and refinement of mechanistic Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) models to support drug discovery and development programs.

• Explore and evaluate artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning approaches to enhance and accelerate QSP modeling workflows.

• Perform Model-Based Meta-Analyses (MBMA) to generate quantitative evidence that informs portfolio strategy and drug development decisions.

• Analyze, integrate, and interpret preclinical and clinical data to support model development and decision-making.

• Learn and implement the industry-standard data handling and modeling rules.

• Prepare internal presentations based on the progress of work on an on-going basis.

• Prepare external poster and manuscript publications, when applicable, which is highly possible and encouraged.

• Support additional CPP team tasks as needed.

Who You Are:

• Strong interest in Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP), mechanistic modeling, and model-informed drug development

• Experience developing or applying mathematical, computational, or systems biology models to address complex biological questions

• Interest in applying AI/ML methods to enhance modeling workflows, data integration, and scientific decision-making

• Proficiency in R, Python, MATLAB, or similar scientific computing tools

• Experience analyzing and interpreting biological, preclinical, clinical, omics, or literature-derived datasets

• Familiarity with meta-analysis, model-based analysis, evidence synthesis, or related quantitative methods

• Strong quantitative reasoning, scientific problem-solving, and critical thinking skills

• Demonstrated ability to independently learn and apply new computational, analytical, and modeling techniques

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex scientific concepts clearly

• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary research environment

title: FinCrime Analyst
description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented FinCrime Analyst who takes ownership, works diligently, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. In this role, you will be on the front lines of financial crime prevention, investigating and responding to alerts related to KYC/KYB discrepancies (e.g., biometric mismatches, fake documents, irregular IDs using Jumio and Persona), as well as PEP/Sanctions/Warnings and transaction monitoring alerts.

You’ll investigate suspicious activity, review and refine transaction monitoring processes, and respond with the assistance of the Compliance Officer to regulatory requests, ensuring compliance while strengthening our AML framework. Collaboration is key-you’ll work with compliance, risk, and operations teams to refine AML prevention strategies and stay ahead of evolving regulations. If you're passionate about fintech, compliance, and making a real impact, we’d love to have you on board!

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Investigate and analyze KYC alerts related to biometric mismatches, fake documents, and irregular IDs using KYC software (e.g., Jumio and Persona) to detect fraudulent activity

- Conduct investigations on PEP (Politically Exposed Persons), Sanctions, and Warnings alerts, ensuring proper risk assessment and compliance with regulatory requirements

- Review, enhance, and optimize transaction monitoring processes to improve detection and reporting of suspicious activities

- Investigate unusual transactional behavior, such as structuring, layering, or irregular cross-border transfers, and escalate as needed

- Respond to requests from regulatory authorities in a timely, accurate, and compliant manner

- Collaborate closely with compliance, risk, and operations teams to strengthen AML controls, improve risk detection, and ensure adherence to internal policies

- Monitor financial crime trends and patterns, leveraging insights to refine AML procedures and strengthen prevention mechanisms

- Stay up to date with evolving AML regulations, industry best practices, and compliance requirements, ensuring the company remains compliant with local and international laws

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Fluency in English and Spanish/Portuguese - Required for handling compliance matters, liaising with authorities, and collaborating with internal teams

- Ability to investigate and analyse KYC discrepancies - Experience with biometric mismatches, fake documents, and tools such as Jumio and Persona

- Strong knowledge of AML & financial crime risks - Understanding of transaction monitoring, typologies, and fraud detection to ensure robust compliance practices

- Hands-on & results-driven mindset - Willing to dive deep into investigations, improve monitoring processes, and take action to strengthen AML frameworks

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience in Compliance, AML, or Financial Fraud Investigations - Helps accelerate learning and enhances risk assessment and regulatory responses

- Experience in Fintech or Financial Services - Familiarity with digital payments and the regulatory challenges of fast-scaling financial institutions

BENEFITS

- Competitive salary

- Discretionary performance bonus

- Paid annual leave

- Latest technology to work with

- Strong team that will help you improve your skills

title: Principal Research Scientist, Robot Foundation Models
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Science Teams

We are looking for a Principal Research Scientist to join the Multi-Embodiment Generalist Agent (MEGA) team within Wayve Science as a founding member. MEGA is building foundation models for general-purpose robots beyond self-driving vehicles. Our focus is on creating intelligent agents that can perceive, reason, move and manipulate the physical world across diverse embodiments, including mobile manipulators, dual-arm platforms and humanoids. This is a senior, high-impact role with genuine 0-to-1 ownership. You will help define the research agenda, technical strategy and foundations of a new robotics program, working alongside world-class researchers in foundation models, embodied intelligence and large-scale machine learning. You will have the opportunity to work across the entire robot-learning stack: building scalable data flywheels, developing new model architectures and learning algorithms, training large models, designing rigorous evaluations and deploying policies on real robots. Your day-to-day work may span vision-language-action models, world and action models, multimodal and omni models, video generation, reinforcement learning, imitation learning and behavioral cloning. You will collaborate closely with researchers, ML engineers, roboticists and hardware teams to move ambitious ideas rapidly from research hypotheses to large-scale experiments and impressive real-world capabilities.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Research in architectures and data around robot foundation models.

- Implement and experiment with different models such as VLAs, WAMs, omni models, and video models.

- Implement and experiment with different learning approaches of the RL/BC kind.

- Synthesize and filter large video datasets.

- Build scalable distributed training pipelines and infrastructure.

- Influence and/or own robot policy development and data decisions.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Lead research into architectures, data and learning approaches for robot foundation models.

- Design, implement and evaluate models such as VLAs, WAMs, omni-modal models, video models and related foundation-model architectures for robotics.

- Explore and develop learning approaches including reinforcement learning, behavioural cloning and other methods relevant to robot policy development.

- Synthesize, curate and filter large-scale video datasets for model training and evaluation.

- Build and use scalable distributed training pipelines and infrastructure for large models and large datasets.

- Influence and/or own technical decisions around robot policy development, data strategy and model design.

- Collaborate closely with scientists, engineers and robotics teams to connect research progress to real-world robot performance.

- Communicate research clearly internally and, where appropriate, contribute to external publications and Wayve’s scientific presence.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- Deep experience in machine learning, with a focus on one or more of: vision-language models, video models, robot policies, or foundation models for robotics or embodied AI.

- Experience with scalable training, such as multi-node training, large datasets and/or large model training.

- Strong research track record, including publications in top-tier venues such as ICRA, CoRL, CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR.

- Strong coding skills and hands-on experience with modern machine learning frameworks.

- Ability to design and drive an independent research agenda while collaborating closely with engineering and robotics teams.

- Experience translating research ideas into working systems, experiments or deployed capabilities

NetImpact Strategies builds software for Federal agencies, and we build it with AI. title: Technical Program Manager, MFG Test Engineering
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE  

As a Technical Program Manager within our Manufacturing Test Engineering Development team, you will provide single-threaded test program ownership of L6 and L10 testing for NPI, sustaining production, qualifications, and test strategy. While the Operations PM owns the factory and schedule, you own test engineering readiness against that schedule, ensuring test engineering is never the surprise at a gate review. You will differentiate this role by translating build milestones into test deliverables at each assembly level, and feeding real constraints back into planning to empower engineers to focus on technical execution.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Maintain an integrated view of every commitment across L6 and L10 NPI, production, qualifications, and test strategy, driving cross-functional dependencies, owners, and timelines in one place.

• Own gate and checkpoint readiness at every L6 and L10 milestone by tracking test coverage, ICT fixture availability, parts lead times, and test software releases to ensure seamless deployments.

• Facilitate strategic communication, conflict resolution, and architectural decisions, identifying risks early and arriving at gate reviews with a recommended mitigation path.

• Absorb status reporting, granular logistics, and dashboard maintenance for team workloads, enabling engineers to remain focused exclusively on technical deliverables.

• Solve for root causes and refine organizational workflows to prevent recurrence, framing trade-offs and forcing closure to ensure continuous program momentum.

WHAT YOU BRING

• A proven track record leading concurrent NPI programs with comprehensive exposure to both board-level (L6) and system-level (L10) manufacturing hardware tests.

• Technical fluency in manufacturing test processes-including ICT, functional test, burn-in, End of Line system test, and yield workflows-enabling you to independently challenge estimates and assess risk.

• Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to compress a complex portfolio into actionable insights tailored for leadership and operational partners.

• Advanced proficiency with program management and tracking tools (such as Jira, Smartsheet, Asana, or Confluence) to synthesize complex data and provide full visibility for successful outcomes.

• A proactive approach to mitigating downstream risks by identifying critical path dependencies early, rather than merely relaying ambiguous problems or managing immediate exceptions.

The Opportunity
This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside - think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters - funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance - but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.
The Role
Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes.
Working Within Our Values:
At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required.
